invariants.name: ActiveAssociationForeignKey
invariants.assertion: An ActiveStore association carries the exact frozen DistributionCommitRecordV1 SchemaId and a non-null foreign key to one earlier existing commit in the same domain kind, domain id, Store Generation, Authority Epoch and namespace.

invariants.name: PreStoreAttemptForeignKey
invariants.assertion: A PreStore association carries one earlier sealed CeremonyAttemptCommitment plus the exact protected carrier, expected-old token and AttemptId; all four values are present together and match one RepositoryV1Cutover or InstallationV1Cutover attempt.

invariants.name: ClosedContextMatrix
invariants.assertion: ActiveStore accepts RepositoryDomain only with the exact c868 RepositoryInstallationClosureV1 SchemaId, or InstallationDomain only with the exact c868 UserAgentInstallationClosureV1 SchemaId. In both branches DistributionCommitRecordV1.receipt_ref, association.distribution_receipt_id and active-head.distribution_receipt_id resolve to the same exact c868 DistributionReceiptV1 SchemaId, whose closed mutation_kind is tag 4 Migrate. PreStore accepts RepositoryV1Cutover with RepositoryDomain or InstallationV1Cutover with InstallationDomain only and binds the same exact Receipt through the association. Every cross-pair fails before publication.

invariants.name: AssociationExactlyOne
invariants.assertion: The normalized association relation has one UNIQUE row for domain kind, domain id, Store Generation, Authority Epoch or pre-store ceremony basis, and terminal Distribution commit or Ceremony Attempt. Missing and duplicate rows fail.

invariants.name: AssociationSingleConsumption
invariants.assertion: Each association is consumed by exactly one matching ActiveStore current-head join or one matching PreStore candidate seal. Reuse by another finality record, domain, Generation, Epoch, Attempt or idempotency meaning fails.

invariants.name: MigrateRequiredNonMigrateForbidden
invariants.assertion: Every successful Migrate publication and every RepositoryV1Cutover or InstallationV1Cutover publication requires exactly one association. Install, Update, Repair, Rollback, Uninstall and every other Ceremony forbid an association.

invariants.name: ActiveAtomicPublication
invariants.assertion: The Distribution commit, Receipt, claim set, snapshot catalog, verification, Installation current Release association when InstallationDomain or explicit Release absence when RepositoryDomain, Operation Result, idempotency outcome, Migration association and current-head join publish in one short same-Store transaction or none become visible.

invariants.name: ActiveHeadRequiredReference
invariants.assertion: The versioned owning current-head join contains required typed identities for both the Distribution commit and Migration association. A reverse lookup, filename, co-location, sidecar or application-only postcheck cannot establish currentness.

invariants.name: PreStoreCandidateMembership
invariants.assertion: The inactive candidate Store root contains the complete association and Distribution closure. The external candidate seal contains required identities for that candidate root and association and is invalid when either is absent or changed.

invariants.name: PreStoreProtectedCas
invariants.assertion: The protected expected-old carrier CAS publishes only the exact complete candidate seal under the matching AttemptId. A crash before CAS leaves inert material; unknown occurrence enters exact-attempt readback reconciliation and never blind retry.

invariants.name: FinalityEqualityClosure
invariants.assertion: Association and finality values exactly equal the owner records for domain, Generation, Epoch where applicable, namespace, Operation or Ceremony, Receipt, claim set, catalog, verification, Result, idempotency identity, candidate seal and consumer gate.

invariants.name: DomainSpecificReleaseClosure
invariants.assertion: The Release value is optional in the association and active-head join. ActiveStore InstallationDomain requires it present and equal across DistributionReceiptV1, DistributionCommitRecordV1, UserAgentInstallationClosureV1, association and active head. PreStore InstallationDomain has no DistributionCommitRecordV1 branch and instead requires the association Release present and equal to DistributionReceiptV1 plus the UserAgent candidate closure contained in the sealed candidate root; the seal binds that root and association. RepositoryDomain requires Release absent in both contexts because RepositoryInstallationClosureV1 has no Release field. No sentinel, inferred Release or cross-domain Release is accepted.

invariants.name: StrictBackwardDag
invariants.assertion: Creation order is deterministically constructed Distribution Receipt and commit or sealed Ceremony Attempt, then association, then current-head join or candidate seal, then protected carrier visibility. The association may reference the earlier same-transaction Receipt and commit, but never a future publication or carrier Receipt, future head or seal, containing root or self hash. Every object-DAG reference is strictly backward.

invariants.name: CompatibilityAdmission
invariants.assertion: The active Generation header or protected locator binds the association SchemaId, finality-edge ManifestId, exact typed SchemaReadWriteSetDescriptorId with four separately typed active-read, active-write, pre-store-read and pre-store-write lists, literal WriterProtocolEpochV1 DescriptorId and literal MigrationEpochV1 DescriptorId. The schema-set descriptor includes the full frozen 38-schema c868 cohort plus the exact context-local finality and compatibility schemas, is strictly sorted and duplicate-free, forbids implicit expansion, and a client lacking any member refuses before reading currentness or interpreting a familiar c868 commit or closure.

invariants.name: ReachabilityRetentionExportGc
invariants.assertion: Current head or candidate seal makes the association, quarantine commitments and protected recovery roots mandatory reachability roots. Sealed export includes them and their protocol identities. Partial or unknown reachability blocks pruning and garbage collection.

invariants.name: RestoreImportCloneNonactivation
invariants.assertion: Restore, import and clone preserve association bytes only as inactive source-qualified history. Activation revalidates the complete finality relation under a fresh destination basis; a c868 commit without its association can remain historical but never become Migrate currentness.

invariants.name: ReplayAndConflict
invariants.assertion: Same-key same-meaning replay returns the identical association, finality and Result without effects. Same key with changed association meaning conflicts; a new key re-evaluates fresh current state and never repairs stale meaning.

invariants.name: SubstitutionFailureMatrix
invariants.assertion: Missing, duplicate, reused, wrong-kind, wrong-domain, wrong-Generation, wrong-Epoch, wrong-namespace, wrong-Release, wrong-Receipt, wrong-Result, wrong-key, wrong-Ceremony, wrong-carrier and changed-candidate substitutions publish nothing.

invariants.name: ConsumerGate
invariants.assertion: Semantic currentness requires the complete active-consumer refusal gate. Protected retention admits only typed sealed readers. Physical pruning requires the later reader-zero, hold-zero, authority, custody, rollback and erasure gates.

invariants.name: CrashAtomicity
invariants.assertion: Fault injection before and after every association, join, seal, Result, idempotency, Store-commit and protected-CAS member proves all-or-none visibility, inert pre-publication material and in-doubt handling for possible carrier crossing.

invariants.name: AdapterParity
invariants.assertion: CLI, JSON, TUI, hooks, shell, Skill and the two read-only MCP Tools render the same finality and refusal meaning. No adapter can infer, mint, omit, repair or activate an association.

invariants.name: C868Isolation
invariants.assertion: MigrationCutoverAssociationV1 is not a DistributionScopedObjectRefV1 target and adds no c868 runtime object kind or edge. The c868 artifact, 38 schemas, 62 components, 61 edges, suite Manifest and edge Manifest remain byte-identical dependencies.

invariants.name: OwnerBoundary
invariants.assertion: Migration owns association meaning and the association write. Distribution owns DistributionCommitRecordV1, DistributionReceiptV1, catalog and verification. RepositoryDomain owns RepositoryInstallationClosureV1 and Repository current-head finality; Installation owns UserAgentInstallationClosureV1 plus Installation current-head and Release association. Their owning publication protocols embed the typed join and publish it atomically with the Migration association. Persistence owns transaction, object, reachability and recovery mechanics only. Integration, Setup, Skill, Recipe, host and adapter text own no write, authority or currentness.
